subject.title: [优化建议] install.sh 模块化拆分以提升可维护性

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a modular `scripts/install.sh` source architecture now, and if so should `openclaw.ai/install.sh` remain a generated single-file public artifact?
rationale: The request is a refactor of a stable public setup surface, while current docs, tests, release artifacts, and website sync assume one served installer script.

options.title: Sponsor a guarded split
options.body: Approve an incremental source split only if it preserves or generates one safe public entrypoint and keeps website sync plus installer smoke proof aligned.

options.title: Allow focused extractions only
options.body: Use this issue as backlog guidance and extract installer sections only when tied to concrete bugs or validation improvements.

options.title: Keep the installer monolithic
options.body: Decide that the served shell installer should stay single-file to minimize helper-loading and packaging risk.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a guarded split
recommendation.body: Approve an incremental source split only if it preserves or generates one safe public entrypoint and keeps website sync plus installer smoke proof aligned.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc is the strongest current routing signal from available blame and recent merged installer/docs work.
